packaging_cascade.cascade_explanation: git_sha differs between the canonical lock generation (HEAD at the method-attestation commit) and every isolated replay (HEAD detached at the later V2-006 result commit); optimizer_correction_lock_sha256 inside the shortlist lock is a hash of the optimizer lock file and therefore cascades from that same git_sha difference in both the original closeout's replay and this provenance checkpoint's replay. No other field differs in either replay.
